data.name: Bitter Silver
data.detailed_description:
A Cowboy Bebop-inspired space western visual novel adventure where you can define your path as bounty hunter Lucia Lopez in the far flung future of the Milky Way Galaxy!

Experience your life as Lucia Lopez - a charismatic ex-soldier turned bounty hunter faced with adversity, tracking down three bounties while dealing with a mysterious affliction.

Aboard your ship, the Athena, is Zap Matters, your fun-loving, half-human, half-alien, partner-in-crime (and love), and Hobbes, your team's resident tech expert and a robotic talking cat.

It's up to you and your team to journey into a city at the fringes of the Milky Way and track down the last three bounties standing in your way of finding the answers Lucia has been seeking all her life about her missing mother.

  • Become the bounty hunter you want to be

    From always knowing the odds to being perfectly in tune with your ship, each background will affect choices you can make throughout the story of Bitter Silver as well as affecting the relationships between you and your crew. You'll even see parts of the story only available to each individual backstory!

  • Experience the story through multiple paths

    Actions, both big and small, will affect Lucia's journey along the way leading to multiple endings based on the choices you make. Who knows how they'll pay off in the end? 

     

  • Take down unique bounty targets, dead or alive, using your skills as a team

    Experience the thrill of taking in bounty targets dead or alive as the leader of a trio of misfits in interactive, comic book-style sequences and be rewarded for your choices with unique ways to utilize your team's skills.

  • Build relationships between you & your misfit crew

    Hang out with Zap and Hobbes outside bounty missions to get know them more. Do you indulge their behavior? Push against it? Or stand back and let them do their thing?

  • Treat your ears to a bebop-filled score

    Enjoy listening to an original score full of jazz, blues, and folk-inspired music to really get you in the spirit of down-on-your-luck bounty hunters.

Play the demo and wishlist today!

data.short_description: You are an intergalactic bounty hunter leading a team of bickering misfits as you track down targets with your words and your weapons to find your missing mom. Make every choice count in this reactive, visual novel love letter to Cowboy Bebop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics Series
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Devices compartible Direct Sound
  • Additional Notes: If you don't think your computer can run a visual novel... see you space cowboy...

  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
